titulo: 'The Survivor': Inside the story of a Spanish woman who posed as a 9/11 victim
cuerpo: Catalan Alicia Esteve spent six years posing as Tania Head, a 9/11 survivor and head of a victims' association. In a new documentary "The Survivor", Kike Maíllo investigates how the lie endured until she was exposed by The New York Times in 2007.
